artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a circular formation with a central figure holding a circular object. The image displays a gathering of haloed figures in a tight composition around a central figure who is prominently holding a circular object. Each figure is intricately detailed with distinctive facial expressions and attire. The color palette consists mainly of subdued tones, with golden accents. The outer perimeter of the image is bordered with an ornate design that frames the entire composition. The scene exudes a sense of harmony and spiritual significance.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene involving figures in a garden setting. The central figure kneels with hands clasped, gazing towards a golden chalice with a cross on top, while surrounded by three other reclining figures. The background includes stylized trees and a decorative floral border.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
artworks.description: The image depicts four individuals engaged in a scene. The central figure is seated and has a serene expression, with long hair and a beard, adorned in a flowing reddish-brown garment with a circular clasp at the chest. Surrounding this figure are three other individuals. One stands to the left, holding a sword or dagger, with a focused expression and short hair. Another person on the right, standing behind the seated figure, appears to be wearing a green headpiece and dark clothing, holding a staff or pole, with a distinct upward gaze. The last individual, kneeling in the foreground, also has short hair and is depicted reaching towards the seated figure with an earnest expression and simple robe. The background consists of ornate floral patterns, with some greenery at the bottom that adds to the decorative style of this scene. The entire scene is framed by a border of intricate floral motifs.

artworks.title: The Expulsion from the Garden of Eden
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in green, red lake, and yellow
artworks.description: The image shows three figures. The person on the left is standing with one arm extended upwards, holding a sword, and wearing a robe-like garment with long sleeves and a belted waist. The other two figures are standing closely together; one with a beard and longer flowing hair while the other has shorter hair, and both are shown without clothing except for fig leaves covering their lower bodies. They exhibit distressed expressions. In the background, there is a tree with green foliage and architectural elements resembling a decorative arch. The ground is depicted with green plants and foliage.

artworks.title: The Visitation
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in green, red lake, and yellow
artworks.description: The image shows two figures standing close to each other. Both individuals have stylized facial features, including prominent eyes, noses, and lips, and are wearing long robes with intricate patterns. They are enveloped in halos and are holding each other's hand and arm. The background features a green area with stylized plants or trees and an earthy texture, framed by a dark border.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in green, red lake, and yellow
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene with figures surrounding the cross. The central wooden cross holds a crucified figure, with individuals standing on either side. All figures wear decorative haloes, except one who holds a sword on the right side. The artwork features bold outlines and vibrant colors like red, green, and yellow, highlighting the clothing and background. The figures exhibit expressive postures, some in gestures of mourning or reverence. The style resembles medieval woodcut or early printmaking with prominent line work and patterns.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in green, red lake, and yellow
artworks.description: This is a painting of a central figure seated on a raised structure with religious and symbolic iconography. The central figure is shown with a halo, holding a long staff with a draped flag. The figure wears a robe in shades of red with yellow highlights. The foreground features intricate patterns and a sense of depth through cross-hatching and bold outlines. Elements like the staff, flag, and implied motion add a dynamic quality to the painting. The color palette is limited, combining muted greens, reds, and yellows against a textured background.

artworks.title: Christ Appearing to Thomas
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in green, red lake, and yellow
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals within a rectangular frame. The figure on the left is depicted standing and holding a long staff with a banner. This person has long hair and a beard, with detailed facial features highlighted in black and surrounded by a yellow halo. They are wearing a draped garment with red and orange hues that falls down to the feet. To the right, the second person is depicted from the waist up in a kneeling position, slightly turned towards the standing figure. This individual also has long hair and a beard, with similar facial detailing and a yellow halo. They are dressed in a garment that mirrors the first in color and pattern. The background consists of stylized grass and foliage in shades of green, with swirling patterns and motifs adorning the banner held by the standing figure. The entire image carries a medieval or woodcut style with bold outlines and a limited color palette.

artworks.title: The Entry into Jerusalem
artworks.artist: German 15th Century
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in red lake, yellow, and green on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure riding a donkey and being greeted by individuals at a gate. The central figure is depicted with flowing hair and a halo, dressed in a long robe, and riding on a donkey. There are other figures around, each with their own halo. The people around seem to be gesturing in a welcoming manner, and one figure is holding a cloth on the ground in front of the donkey. The background features detailed patterns and arches, with contrasting colors of red, green, and gold highlighted throughout. The style of this piece is reminiscent of medieval religious art, with its use of line, pattern, and color similar to stained glass designs or illuminated manuscripts.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.artist: German 15th Century
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in red lake, yellow, and green on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group gathered around a table with a central figure. The image illustrates a scene where a central figure is depicted with a gesture that suggests a moment of importance. This figure is surrounded by other characters, who also have halos. The setting involves a table with a chalice and a plate. The characters display expressions of attentiveness or reverence. The color palette includes earth tones with touches of green, red, and yellow. The style of the painting combines elements of medieval religious art and printmaking techniques.

artworks.title: The Flagellation
artworks.artist: German 15th Century
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in red lake, yellow, and green on laid paper
artworks.description: This painting features three figures engaged in an activity involving ropes or cords. The central figure has a circular radiance around the head and is scantily clad. Flanking this figure are two others, one in red and the other in green with red trousers, who appear to be holding ropes or whips directed towards the central figure. The background shows an elaborately detailed architectural setting with stone or mosaic walls, arches, and floral designs, in a medieval or early Renaissance style. The predominant colors are red, green, and gold.

artworks.title: Ornamental Alphabet
artworks.artist: German 15th Century
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: This is a drawing of stylized alphabet letters in an elaborate calligraphic style. The artwork features a complete set of uppercase letters arranged in three horizontal rows. Each letter is embellished with swirls, flourishes, and patterns resembling ribbons and motifs. The background is a light color, enhancing the vintage appearance of the lettering.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in green, light rose, and yellow
artworks.description: The image shows several figures gathered around a table. The central figure is seated while others are seated or kneeling. The main character has distinct facial features with a long beard and long stylized hair. They are wearing robes like the surrounding figures. Some figures are holding or gesturing towards objects on the table, including a platter with loaves of bread and fish. All figures have halos. The background is filled with overlapping figures, and the art uses black outlines, shading, and minimal color.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in green, light rose, and yellow
artworks.description: The image shows several figures interacting closely together. The central figure is wearing a long robe, a round brooch, and a crown of thorns. Surrounding this person are three other figures in various poses. The figure to the left has a bearded face and a head covering, while the individual to the right is holding a long object. Below the central figure, a fourth person is kneeling in profile. The background features geometric and textured elements, including a wooden structure and a checkered pattern with green accents.

artworks.title: The Pietà
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in green, light rose, and yellow
artworks.description: The image depicts four figures. Three are shown in full bodies and the fourth is partially visible, supported horizontally by the others. The central figure is depicted with long hair and a beard, wearing a robe. The surrounding figures are in an upright sitting or kneeling position, each with distinct facial features characterized by gentle, serene expressions, and they are adorned with halos around their heads. They appear to be wearing robes with patterns and headdresses. The background showcases a large wooden cross spanning the top, suggesting an outdoor setting. Grass elements are shown in the foreground. The artwork is framed by a border.

artworks.title: The Three Maries at the Tomb
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in green, light rose, and yellow
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures around a patterned box or container. The artwork uses bold outlines and minimal colors, including blacks, whites, muted tones, and touches of green. The figures wear traditional robes and have halos above their heads. The central focus is a rectangular object with circular and dotted patterns. The composition shows symmetry and balance through horizontal alignment of the figures, who appear contemplative. The use of simple patterns and limited color creates a historical and solemn atmosphere.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child in Glory
artworks.artist: German 15th Century or Master of the Meshed Background
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red, and green
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures: a woman and a child. The woman is standing and holding the child on her lap. She has long hair, wears a starry crown, and a radiating halo. Her expression is gentle. She wears a robe with green and reddish-brown colors, gold trimmings, and intricate patterns. The child has curly hair, wears a cloth around the waist, and also has a halo. They are close to each other, with the child leaning towards the woman. Both figures are surrounded by a radiant glow. The background shows a pattern resembling cloud-like waves.

artworks.title: The Madonna Enthroned with Eighteen Holy Women
artworks.artist: German 15th Century or Master with the Mountain-Like Clouds
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in green, yellow, and red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features multiple figures, a woman sitting on a throne holding a child, with other individuals surrounding them. The central woman wears elaborate robes and a crown or halo. The child also has a halo. The figures wear long flowing garments. The background shows angelic beings and haloes. The scene is in a detailed border with floral and geometric patterns. The outer border has floral motifs.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in His Study
artworks.artist: German 15th Century or Master of the Aachen Madonna
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in rust-red lake, green, and yellow
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated figure facing forward. The person has a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a serious expression. They wear a wide-brimmed hat, a long robe with intricate designs, and hold an object resembling a staff. A lion stands next to them, resting a paw on their knee, and there is a structure resembling a book cabinet in the background, with open books and decorative objects around it. Architectural elements like spires are visible in the backdrop.

artworks.title: Saint Matthias and Saint Jude with Articles from the Credo
artworks.artist: Attributed to Master d
artworks.medium: metalcut, hand-colored in olive green, dull red lake and yellow
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals holding keys and books, positioned against a backdrop of a checkerboard floor and an architectural setting. The person on the left has curly hair and an oval face, holding a key and book over one shoulder. The person on the right has a curly beard and hair, holding a key and book and facing forward. Both individuals wear long, flowing robes in earthy tones with beige underlayers. Each figure is depicted with a round golden halo behind their head with inscriptions.

artworks.title: Saint Barbara
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Cologne Arms
artworks.medium: metalcut on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a flowing robe with intricate patterns and textures standing upright. They wear a crown with ornate designs and have long, wavy hair. The face is smooth and somewhat expressionless with delicate features. The person holds a palm frond in the left hand and a tower-like structure in the right hand. The background is intricately decorated with floral motifs, and the floor is patterned with geometric shapes.

artworks.title: Saint Roche
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Cologne Arms
artworks.medium: metalcut
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing up and holding a staff in their right hand. They wear long robes with a patterned texture, a sash across the chest, and have long wavy hair. A smaller kneeling figure with wings is next to them, along with a small animal nearby. The background shows a detailed floral and geometric wall pattern, with architectural features above. "SEB + TO + HUB" is written at the bottom.

artworks.title: Playing Card
artworks.artist: German 15th Century
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: The image features black, curved lines on a textured beige background. The lines form an abstract pattern that could be interpreted as resembling an animal figure.

artworks.title: The Baptism of Christ; Pharoah Passing through the Red Sea; Joshua and Caleb
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 15th Century
artworks.medium: woodcut (block book page) on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene depicting biblical narratives and figures. The central portion shows a significant religious event with a central figure surrounded by others. Flanking this centerpiece are smaller scenes. On the left, there is a gathering of figures, and on the right, individuals are carrying a bunch of grapes. The upper portion features two figures in dialogue and accompanying text. The bottom portion also shows two seated figures and more text. The drawing is intricate, with detailed lines suggesting a meticulous style focused on religious storytelling.
